correctness.rationale: The normalized Weyl eigenvalue calculation gives exact integer character sums. Gold derivatives have exactly two-point nonempty fibers and yield the universal horizontal band. The quadratic trace polar radical reduces to a binomial power equation, whose gcd gives 2-point radicals in odd degrees and 1- or 4-point radicals in even degrees. Walsh autocorrelation proves magnitude and support counts, fixing all multiplicities; the kernel is the exact zero set. Exact finite field programs independently checked all ambiguity indices for m=2..5, and zero-translation plus differential fibers for m=6; this finite test is not confused with the general proof.

value.rationale: This completely classifies a natural matrix tomography reconstruction spectrum on a canonical APN graph, including the full kernel and precise conditioning; its even/odd arithmetic change is not detectable from APN differential data alone. The APN iff criterion identifies the structural origin of the dominant band and affine/CCZ invariance moves the result to entire equivalence classes. Its value is a motivated, nontrivial exact invariant, not novelty from routine parameter renaming.
